n: Event <Retracing Our Steps> is now open

missions: Clear event stages 15 times, not including tutorial stages
Clear event stages 45 times, not including tutorial stages
Clear event stages 85 times, not including tutorial stages

list: Gold-embroidered blue silk curtain, hanging above the visitor's sofa with a simple metal frame. Here is where the most important battles in business are fought. Sitting underneath it means that negotiation has begun.

Small stone platform with gray book stand. The books on it are regularly rotated. Degenbrecher reads books here in the morning if there is no mission or training scheduled, a habit she has maintained over the years.
Warm and comfortable sofa with extra blue padding. There will always be tough customers. The first step to reaching an agreement satisfactory to both sides is to sit calm and collected.

Coffee machine with simple colors. The rack next to it holds newspapers and magazines. The importance of information in negotiations goes without saying. The publications here come from major media across Terra.
Armless sofa with a unique design, with a simple storage shelf on the side. All important matters in Karlan Trade's business goes through SilverAsh. He has negotiated with countless guests here.

Lamp supported by a metal frame. The lights on the two sides use different designs. When there is a blizzard outside, Matterhorn sets up a table under the lamp to share his highly-regarded handmade dishes.
Stone column with snowy mountain symbols, surrounded by rough mountain rocks that serve as both protection and decoration. The chaos of the Catastrophe has passed. The faith of Kjerag remains strong.
Lightweight storage shelf, ingeniously creating storage space with its twists and bends. A flower from the snowy mountains blooms above the shelf, demonstrating the beauty of the Snow Realm.
Small chair with a stone base, hollowed to make it easy to move. When the weather is too poor to travel, employees ask guests to sit down and serve warm drinks.
Display board for various announcements. A blue gem is embedded on the stone board. It was surrounded by people and sounds of surprise when the announcement of changes in management was posted.
It collects every rarely-seen sight out there. It is only waiting for you to set out.
theme: A recreation of Karlan Trade's reception room. The contracts signed on the desk are the result of crises and transformation, the picture of unity hiding the turmoil beneath the surface.

list:
You now know the weight of a heart, and the suffering and salvation along the heart-seeker's road.
Those with desire, those with dedication, those with devotion and reverence, those with the courage to rebel, may find their heart of hearts.
During the Retracing Our Steps event, obtain the free Operator Astgenne the Lightchaser

You ran into Elena as she was leading an energy survey team in the snows.
As radiant as the stars, with a heart as resolute as a boulder. That's just how her clumsy, precious movements are.
During the Retracing Our Steps event, spend 4000 Multi-functional Snow Detectors at the [Observatory Support Division]

Your ample function testing and information retrieval was of vital import to Rhine Lab's probe research.
The researcher in charge will put your name at the very front of the acknowledgments. The day it's published, all will know your name.
Complete all the content in [Oracular Riddles] and collect the rewards

A riddle, the most basic form of question and answer.
The seekers no longer seek, the questioners no longer question. Rise from the straw prayer mat, and with your two unfettered legs, walk a new road.
In [Karlan Trade R&D], clear a total of 8 rebuilding regions

You walk among the ruins, the once-gleaming trains still before your eyes.
Resource allocation and time management have proven to be rigorous tests of your ability. Oh, and take care, the floor's slippery.
During the Retracing Our Steps event, use Avalanche Trigger System, Snow Retention System, or Avalanche Control System 15 times

Distant, docile snow is a beautiful sight. Approaching, tumbling snow is a disaster.
Put down your broom—we won't be able to use it for a while.
Complete all stages in [Pilgrimage through Blizzards] with 3-star ratings

You have witnessed a wayward pilgrimage.
The law states that once the Saintess leaves the Vine-Bead Court, she is to tour the mountains of Kjerag alone, using her two feet to measure the weight of faith and prayer.
Complete all stages in [Road of Reformation] on Challenge Mode

You walk alongside the trailblazer of transformation. The heavy curtain is pulled back for the both of you.
Eyes that see the way through the blizzard, hands that dig tinder out of cold soil, courage that sets legs walking across the ice. They come together to form the him you know.
Complete all stages in [Heart of Karlan] on Challenge Mode

You wait within the crowd. Some journeys must begin by one's own hand.
One step, then another. 'Where are we going?', you hear someone ask. Then another step.
During the Retracing Our Steps event, flip 30 Frostdillos

Kjerag has no zoo. The animals here are freer than you imagined, and are more willing to be friends to humanity.
Your new friend is showing you how nimble its flips are again. Please prepare to applaud and offer a treat.
set: Retracing Our Steps Engraved Medal Set

A set of engraved medals that record the entirety of the chaos, mutual cooperation, and change that came to Kjerag.
The winter nights have passed, and spring is just around the corner.
